evidence.reason: This is a test-granularity/hardening suggestion rather than evidence of a current defect. `test_post_boundary_activation_refusal_is_required` deliberately supplies one combined fixture in which both post-boundary activations succeed (manager `after_phase.direct.rc=0` and reboot `after_phase.dependency.rc=0`) and asserts `mask_persisted` is False; that is a valid check of the combined scenario and passes. The finding only observes that a hypothetical verifier ignoring the reboot branch would also satisfy this test—no actual verifier bug is demonstrated, and no vm.py implementation is supplied showing wrong behavior. Adding independent cases would enlarge test coverage (a hardening proposal), not repair an incorrect result, and no contract clause requires per-branch test isolation.
